name: Adam Kubert
deck: Adam began his career in comics at the age of twelve lettering for DC Comics where his father, Joe Kubert, was an editor/artist. Since then he has pencilled for all the top publishers. Adam’s work includes drawing the X-Men, Fantastic Four, The Incredible Hulk, Spider-Man, Superman, Ghost Rider and most notably, Wolverine. In addition to his father, Adam's brother Andy is also a comic book artist. Both teach at the Kubert School in Dover, NJ which was founded by Joe Kubert.

name: Al Gordon
deck: Writer, inker

name: Al Milgrom
deck: Al Milgrom is a comic book writer, illustrator (pen and inks) and editor for Marvel Comics. He co-created Firestorm with Gerry Conway in 1978. He was Marvel's editor for the majority of the 80's, until being fired in early 2000 after insulting former editor Bob Harras in a phrase hidden in a comic. He has since been working for Marvel again and other comic book companies.

name: Alan Davis
deck: A British artist and writer known for his work on Uncanny X-Men, Captain Britain, and Excalibur.

name: Alan Kupperberg
deck: Alan Kupperberg was an American comics artist who has worked on both comic books and comic strips.

name: Andrew Currie
deck: UK artist.

name: Andy Kubert
deck: Andy Kubert is the youngest son of comic book artist Joe Kurbert. Andy, like his father and his brother Adam Kubert, is an illustrator who is well known for successful runs on X-Men, Batman, and Flashpoint.

name: Andy Lanning
deck: Andy Lanning is a British artist, writer and inker.

name: Andy Schmidt
deck: Senior Editor at IDW and Former Assistant Editor at Marvel.

name: Annette Kawecki
deck: Letterer and artist.

name: Archie Goodwin
deck: Editor in Chief at Marvel Comics in the 1970's. He also wrote several comics for Marvel. He would later go on to edit titles for DC.

name: Ariel Olivetti
deck: Olivetti is an Argentinian comic book artist.

name: Armando Gil
deck: Artist and inker from the Dominican Republic who worked for Marvel in the seventies and eighties.

name: Arnold Drake
deck: Writer who worked for DC and Marvel in a career spanning from the 50s to 80s, winner of the 2005 Eisner Award for Excellence in Comic Writing. Legendary creator of such characters as Beast Boy, Doom Patrol, Deadman, Polaris and others.

name: Art Thibert
deck: Art Thibert is an Eisner and Harvey award nominated inker whose career spans almost 25 years.

name: Artie Simek
deck: Arthur "Artie" Simek, sometimes credited as Art Simek (January 6, 1916 - February 1975), was an American calligrapher best known as a letterer for Marvel Comics during the period fans and historians call the Silver Age of Comic Books.

name: Barry Grossman (Ben Sean)
deck: Colorist who has also worked under pseudonym Ben Sean.

name: Bill Everett
deck: Golden Age-Comic Legend who created both Namor and Daredevil. He drew for Atlas, Timely and Marvel Comics.

name: Bill Jemas
deck: Past-president of Marvel and one of the creators of the Ultimate Marvel Universe. He is also co founder AWA Studios.

name: Bill Mantlo
deck: Writer, mostly for Marvel Comics in the 1970s and 80s, with a rich, humanistic tone to his stories.

name: Bill Oakley
deck: Comic Book Letterer.

name: Bob Brown
deck: Bob Brown was an American Comic Book Artist. His Career spanned from the 1940`s - 1970`s. His most notable works were, Space Ranger, Challengers of The Unknown, Daredevil and Super boy. Co-Creator of Talia and Multi-Man.

name: Bob Budiansky
deck: Wrote most of the US Marvel Transformers comics.

name: Bob Forgione
deck: Artist who worked for Atlas/Marvel in the 1950s and 60s.

name: Bob Hall
deck: Writer and artist

name: Bob Harras
deck: Robert "Bob" Harras (b. January 11, 1959) is an American comics writer and editor, who was editor-in-chief of Marvel Comics from 1995 to 2000. He has been DC Comics' Editor-In-Chief since September 2010.

name: Bob Layton
deck: Bob Layton is best known for his works on Iron Man and Hercules at Marvel and for being the Editor of Valiant comics during its peak.

name: Bob Sharen
deck: Bob Sharen is a comic book colorist. He's worked for Marvel on "The Amazing Spider-Man", "She-Hulk", "Ghost Rider", and "the West Coast Avengers" among others.

name: Bob Wiacek
deck: Comic book artist, primarily an inker

name: Bobbie Chase
deck: Writer, editor who has worked at Marvel and DC.

name: Brent Eric Anderson
deck: Artist.

name: Brett Breeding
deck: An inker who began working for Marvel in the 1980s, and then moved to DC Comics

name: Bruce Patterson
deck: An American inker and artist.

name: Carlos Pacheco
deck: Carlos Pacheco was a Spanish comic book artist and penciller. He is best known for his work on titles such as X-Men, Green Lantern, and Avengers Forever.

name: Charlotte Jetter
deck: Letterer who worked for Charlton, Marvel and DC in the 50s, 60s and 70s.

name: Chris Claremont
deck: An American comic book writer, famed for his legendary run on Uncanny X-Men. His tenure on the title, which lasted from 1976 to 1991, is considered to be one of the greatest in the history of the medium.

name: Chris Giarrusso
deck: Artist. Creator of the G-Man comic and the Mini-Marvels.

name: Chris Ivy
deck: Longtime artist/inker for Marvel and DC Comics.

name: Chris Lichtner
deck: Also known as Christian Lichtner

name: Chris Sotomayor
deck: Colorist

name: Christie Scheele
deck: A colorist for Marvel.

name: Chuck Austen
deck: Born Chuck Beckum. A controversial writer on Uncanny X-Men, Elektra, War Machine and Superman. Known more for his writing, Austen also handled art duties on U.S. War Machine and Elektra using 3D rendering programs.

name: Comicraft
deck: Founded by Richard Starkings, Comicraft provides lettering services for comic books. Some of its members include Rob Steen, Albert Deschesne, and Jimmy Betancourt.

name: Dan Adkins
deck: He was a comic book writer, penciller, inker & cover artist from the mid 1960s to the early 1990s.

name: Dan Buckley
deck: Dan Buckley is publisher of Marvel Comics and the chief operating officer of Marvel Entertainment's publishing division.

name: Dan Green
deck: Inker, been in the business for decades.

name: Dave Cockrum
deck: An American comic artist who helped rebirth the X-Men, creating some of the most iconic characters to date.

name: Dave DeVries
deck: Australian comic book writer and artist.

name: Dave Hunt
deck: American artist and inker

name: Dave Lanphear
deck: Dave Lanphear is a cartoonist and newspaper illustrator who has lettered hundreds of comics since 1991, working for virtually every publisher at some time or another. He has also created fonts for publishers directly, and for sale at http://www.myfonts.com/person/Dave_Lanphear/. His gallery is posted at www.coroflot.com/artmonkeys.

name: David Anthony Kraft
deck: Comicbook writer for Marvel comics in the 1970's.

name: David Finch
deck: David Finch is a comic book artist/writer born in Canada. He has taken on his own series Batman: The Dark Knight where is writing and penciling but is known for his monumental covers such as Action Comics #900.

name: David Michelinie
deck: Wrote the second longest run of The Amazing Spider-Man. Only Stan Lee wrote more.

name: Denise Wohl
deck: Letterer for Marvel

name: Derec Donovan
deck: Derec Donovan, formerly known as Derec Aucoin, is an American comic book illustrator from Louisiana.

name: Diana Albers
deck: American comic book letterer.

name: Dick Ayers
deck: Silver Age and Bronze Age artist best known for his Horror, War and Western Comics which he drew frequently for DC and Marvel.

name: Dick Giordano
deck: Legendary comic book artist and editor.

name: Digital Chameleon
deck: Coloring studio.

name: Don Heck
deck: “Dashing” Don Heck was a legendary comic book artist who co-created Iron Man, Hawkeye, Black Widow and Wonder Man.

name: Don Newton
deck: Comic Book Artist. Mostly working for Charlton and DC Comics.

name: Don Perlin
deck: Famous writer of many of Marvel's most respected comic-books in the 1970's.

name: Don Warfield
deck: Colorist who worked for Marvel during the 70s.

name: Duffy Vohland
deck: American artist.

name: Edgar Delgado
deck: A Mexican comic book colorist.

name: Elaine Heinl
deck: Has done the lettering for several marvel series such as The Defenders and The Avengers. He also has done some work as a colourist on a few issues of The Defenders and the Human Fly and a few other Marvel titles.

name: Ernie Chan
deck: Ernesto "Ernie" Chan was a Filipino-American comic book artist probably most well known for his work on the various Conan the Barbarian properties for Marvel. He also worked on Batman and Detective Comics for DC.

name: Frank Bolle
deck: Bolle was born and raised in New York City. An inveterate doodler he remembers that as a child he drew on any scrap of paper he could find. He went to the High School of Music and Art. And then served with the Army Air Force from 1943 to 1946. After the war, Bolle found work in the booming comic book industry while attending Pratt Institute to continue his studies where he graduated with honors. Frank is one of the most prolific comic book artists of all time, with his career starting in 1948.

name: Frank Chiaramonte
deck: Artist who worked for both DC and Marvel including long runs on the Superman titles. Sometimes credited as Frank Monte.

name: Frank McLaughlin
deck: Frank Mclaughlin was a comic artist and inker primarily for DC comics as well as Marvel and Charlton.

name: Frank Quitely
deck: Frank Quitely is a Scottish artist acclaimed for his frequent collaborations with writer Grant Morrison, including New X-Men, All-Star Superman, WE3, Batman and Robin, and Flex Mentallo.

name: Françoise Mouly
deck: Editor, publisher, designer, and artist.

name: Gary Frank
deck: Gary Frank is a British comic book artist.

name: Gaspar Saladino
deck: Gaspar Saladino is a letterer, primarily for DC Comics

name: Gene Colan
deck: Gene "The Dean" Colan was a legendary comic book artist whose career spanned from 1944 to 2009. He is the co-creator of Blade and The Falcon.

name: Gene Day
deck: Artist who worked in the world of underground comic publications, as well as Skywald Publications and Marvel Comics.

name: Geoff Johns
deck: Geoff Johns is the CEO for Mad Ghost Productions at Warner Brothers. He previously wrote Action Comics, Justice Society of America, Flash, Aquaman, Teen Titans prior to focusing on movies. He is also known for his historic nine-year run on Green Lantern in which he greatly expanded the mythos.

name: George Klein
deck: Inker for many Golden Age and Silver Age comic books for Marvel Comics and DC Comics.

name: George Pérez
deck: Multi-Award Winning Comic Book Legend. George Perez has worked for both DC and Marvel. George is the creator of dozens of popular characters including Cyborg, Cheetah, Cheshire, Deathstroke, Raven and Starfire.

name: George Roussos
deck: Inker and letterer from the 1940s to the 1980s for Marvel and DC.

name: George Tuska
deck: George Tuska was an artist for Marvel during the 1970's.

name: Gerry Conway
deck: Gerard F. "Gerry" Conway is an American writer of comic books and television shows. He is best known for co-creating the Marvel Comics vigilante The Punisher (with artist Ross Andru) and scripting the death of the character Gwen Stacy during his long run on The Amazing Spider-Man. He is also known for co-creating the DC Comics superhero Firestorm (with artist Al Milgrom), and for scripting the first major, modern-day intercompany crossover, Superman vs. the Amazing Spider-Man.

name: Gil Kane
deck: Comic book Legend who worked through the Gold, Silver, Bronze, Copper and Modern ages of comics. Legendary creator of Hal Jordan, Iron Fist, Abin Sur, Atom, Guy Gardner and Sinestro to name a few.

name: Gina Going-Raney
deck: Colorist

name: Glenn Alan Herdling
deck: Writer, editor who worked for Marvel and Malibu.

name: Glynis Oliver Wein
deck: Hard-working colorist for Marvel Comics for many years, she has gone by her maiden name Glynis Oliver since 1985.

name: Gregg Schigiel
deck: Artist who has done work for Marvel.

name: H.E. Huntley
deck: Ernest Hart was a writer who worked for Marvel during the 60s.

name: Harlan Ellison
deck: Harlan Ellison was an American writer primarily known for his prose fiction and non-fiction essays. In addition to some original comics writing, he allowed many of his stories to be adapted to comics.

name: Hugh Paley
deck: Hubert 'Hugh' Paley is a colorist that has worked for Marvel Comics.

name: Irene Vartanoff
deck: Irene Vartanoff is an author, artist, and has published numerous products for DC Comics.

name: Irving Watanabe
deck: Irving Watanabe is a editor for marvel and is credited for many marvel comic books

name: Ivan Reis
deck: A Brazillian comic book artist.

name: J.G. Jones
deck: A comic book artist, known primarily for his acclaimed cover work.

name: Jack Kirby
deck: One of the medium's most prolific artistic legends, Jack Kirby, "The King of Comics," was an artist, writer, and editor whose work spanned the Golden, Silver, Bronze and Modern ages of comics. Kirby created and co-created a multitude of Marvel and DC's most popular characters and many others, too. Kirby was one of the most respected artists of his time (though he didn't have personal knowledge of that, until later on), and remains so today.

name: Jack Morelli
deck: Jack Morelli is a letterer that has worked for Marvel Comics. Jack is sometimes credited as John Morelli.

name: Jae Lee
deck: Jae Lee is a penciler, inker and Eisner Award winning artist who has worked for several publishers including DC Comics, Image and Marvel being mostly known for his work on Inhumans, Namor, the-Submariner and the Dark Tower series.

name: Janice Chiang
deck: Letterer and Colorist who worked with Marvel and DC Comics.

name: Janice Cohen
deck: Colourist and occasional letterer

name: Jason Levine
deck: Letterer Supreme

name: Jason Wright
deck: Colorist.

name: Jean Simek Izzo
deck: Letterer who has worked for Marvel & DC among others.

name: Jeff Smith
deck: Jeff Smith is an independent writer and artist best known for his multi-award winning fantasy epic comic book "Bone" which was first published from the early 1990s to the early 2000s.

name: Jeff Youngquist
deck: Jeff Youngquist is an editor at Marvel Comics, that works in the collections and special projects department.

name: Jerry Ordway
deck: Jerry Ordway is known for his 7 years run on Superman between 1986-1993 & revamping Captain Marvel in the mini-series The Powers of Shazam. He was also one of the inkers for Crisis on Infinite Earths.

name: Jim Cheung
deck: Jim Cheung is a comic book artist who has helped in the creation of many superheroes and villains.

name: Jim Mooney
deck: A Gold- Silver and Bronze age artist and a Legendary creator who developed such notables as Mystique, Spider Woman, Phantom Girl, Brainiac 5, and Hellstorm. Also worked under the Pseudonym Jay Noel.

name: Jim Novak
deck: He is a comic book creator primarily working as a letterer for Marvel Comics. Novak has also done spot duty as a writer, penciler and colorist.

name: Jim Salicrup
deck: Jim Salicrup was been a writer and editor of many books.

name: Jim Shooter
deck: James Shooter is a comic book writer, occasional fill-in artist, editor, and publisher. He worked at Marvel Comics for almost 25 years, before (co-)founding Valiant Comics, Defiant Comics, and Broadway Comics. He has also appeared as a character in a number of stories.

name: Jim Starlin
deck: Jim Starlin is a legend in comics. He established his talent on Captain Marvel, and his work on Adam Warlock, Thanos & (creator owned) Dreadstar, Batman and others. He is known for his contributions to Cosmic books as well as being the "Grim Reaper" of comics.

name: Joe Bennett
deck: Brazilian comic book artist

name: Joe Giella
deck: Legendary Inker, famously known for his work on Flash, Green Lantern, Batman and Detective Comics. He studied at the Art Student League alongside Joe Kubert. Mr. Giella received the Inkpot award in 1996. Also worked as a Ghost Artist for Bob Kane in the Batman comic strip.

name: Joe Maneely
deck: Joe Maneely was a comic book artist, best known for his work at Atlas (later Marvel) comics. He died at age 32 in a train accident, just before the birth of Marvel Comics.

name: Joe Quesada
deck: Joseph Quesada is an American comic book editor, writer and artist. He is former editor-in-chief of Marvel Comics and current Chief Creative Officer of Marvel Entertainment.

name: Joe Rosen
deck: Letterer.

name: Joe Rubinstein
deck: Comics inker, portrait painter, illustrator, teacher and murals.

name: Joe Sinnott
deck: Joe Sinnott was a legendary Marvel comics inker who had been in the business for over 70 years. A true legend in the business.

name: John Buscema
deck: "Big" John Buscema was a comic book artist whose talent made him an industry leader throughout the 1960s, 1970s and 1980s in such Marvel titles as Conan The Barbarian and The Silver Surfer.

name: John Byrne
deck: John Byrne is a prolific superhero comic book writer and artist, and is well recognized for the changes he imparts to comic mythologies. He is most famous for his work on Alpha Flight, Avengers, Fantastic Four, She-Hulk, Uncanny X-Men, and West Coast Avengers for Marvel Comics and Superman and Wonder Woman for DC Comics. His many other projects include his creator-owned 2112 and Next Men series.

name: John Cassaday
deck: John Cassaday was an American comic book artist, well known for his work on Planetary, Captain America, Astonishing X-Men and Star Wars.

name: John Costanza
deck: He is a comic book letterer and artist for DC and Marvel comics. Sometimes credited as Jon Costa.

name: John G Roshell
deck: Letterer and designer.

name: John Ostrander
deck: Writer known for his series Grimjack as well as acclaimed lengthy tenures on DC's Suicide Squad, The Spectre, Firestrom and Martian Manhunter. He has also written several Star Wars comics at Dark Horse.

name: John Romita
deck: John Romita is one of the legendary "Marvel Bullpen" artists of the Silver Age of comics. Co-Creator of Mary Jane Watson, The Punisher and Wolverine.

name: John Romita Jr.
deck: The son of legendary comic book artist John Romita. He has worked at Marvel for the majority of his career.

name: Jon Sibal
deck: Inker sometimes credited as Jonathan Sibal.

name: José Villarrubia
deck: Colorist

name: Julianna Ferriter
deck: Colorist

name: June Braverman
deck: Artist

name: Klaus Janson
deck: Klaus Janson is a German-born American comic book artist. He has regularly worked with John Romita Jr. and has worked with Grant Morrison on Batman Gothic. His run on Daredevil with Frank Miller is one of his most celebrated.

name: Kurt Busiek
deck: Kurt Busiek is a critically acclaimed writer of numerous titles for many comics publishers.

name: Larry Lieber
deck: Brother of Stan Lee and Legendary comic book writer, artist and co-creator of Iron Man, Thor, Loki and Odin (to name a few)

name: Lee Weeks
deck: Legendary Comic artist who has worked with Marvel on projects such as Spider-Man and World War Hulk among other things.

name: Len Wein
deck: Writer and editor, Len Wein created famous characters such as Swamp Thing, Human Target and Wolverine. Editor-in-Chief of DC Comics during Crisis on Infinite Earths and Watchmen.

name: Liquid!
deck: A coloring studio mostly known for it's revolutionary color-work in the late 1990's and early 2000's.

name: Luke Ross
deck: Brazilian comic book artist Luciano Queiros, best known by his pen name Luke Ross, He has been drawing comics since early '90s for Marvel, DC, Dark Horse, Image, etc. Some of his best known works are Spectacular Spider-Man for Marvel, Jonah Hex for DC and Samurai: Heaven and Earth for Dark Horse. Since 2008 Luke has been an exclusive artist to Marvel Comics working on titles such as Captain America, Avengers, Amazing Spider-Man, Dark Tower: The Gunslinger, Secret Avengers, Iron Man and many others.

name: Manuel Garcia
deck: Comic book artist. Currently exclusive with Marvel.

name: Many Hands
deck: This is a Pseudonym used to indicate a group of artists that collaborated together in an effort to complete an issue that was in danger of missing its deadline.

name: Marc Sumerak
deck: Marc is a freelance writer, and is currently best known as the writer of multiple Marvel Comics projects including Marvel Age: Fantastic Four, and Ororo: Before the Storm.

name: Margeaux Pepoy
deck: American comic book Writer, Penciller, Artist, Inker.

name: Marie Severin
deck: One of the few women working in comics in the Golden and Silver Ages, Marie Severin is a Harvey and Eisner award winning artist. Her brother is comic book artist John Severin.

name: Mark Bagley
deck: Mark Bagley is an American comic book artist. He has worked for Marvel Comics and DC Comics. He has worked on titles such as The Amazing Spider-Man, Thunderbolts, New Warriors, and Ultimate Spider-Man.

name: Mark Farmer
deck: Mark Farmer is a British comic book artist who has worked on Incredible Hulk and Fantastic Four.

name: Mark Gruenwald
deck: Mark Gruenwald was a writer and editor at Marvel Comics. In fact, regarded by many readers and creators as the finest editor Marvel ever saw. Gruenwald was known for his encyclopaedic knowledge of almost everything Marvel which also led him to spearheading the Official Handbooks to the Marvel Universe. Mark was known for his work on Squadron Supreme and Captain America which lasted for ten years.

name: Mark Waid
deck: Mark Waid is an American writer, considered to be one of the most influential writers of the 1990s. His expansive works includes The Flash, JLA, and Kingdom Come for DC and Captain America for Marvel. He is currently writing Batman/Superman: World's Finest and Superman: The Last Days of Lex Luthor for DC.

name: Marv Wolfman
deck: One-time Editor in Chief at Marvel, Wolfman is probably best known for his work on Marvel horror books such as Tomb of Dracula as well as Crisis on Infinite Earths and the Teen Titans for DC. Inducted into the Eisner Hall of Fame in 2011.

name: Matt Idelson
deck: DC editor

name: Michael Golden
deck: Michael Golden is an American comic-book artist . He is best known for his work on Marvel's "The Micronauts" in the 70's, and "The Nam" in the 1980's. He also co-created "Rogue" in the 1980's for Marvel, and "Bucky O'Hare" in the 1990's for Continuity.

name: Michael Higgins
deck: Michael Higgins has worked as both a writer, letterer and editor.

name: Mike Carlin
deck: Michael "Mike" Carlin is a comic book writer and editor.

name: Mike Esposito
deck: Mike Esposito was a prolific inker at both Marvel and DC comics. Used the pseudonyms Mickey Demeo and Joe Gaudioso at Marvel.

name: Mike Friedrich
deck: Notable writer for Marvel and DC Comics and the independant series Star*Reach.

name: Mike Stevens
deck: A Letterer who worked for Marvel and DC during the 70s.

name: Neal Adams
deck: Legend and creator rights advocate. Neal Adams was inducted into the Will Eisner Comic Book Hall of Fame in 1998, and the Jack Kirby Hall of Fame in 1999. Co-Creator of classic characters Ra's al Ghul, John Stewart and Man Bat (to name a few).

name: Nel Yomtov
deck: Nel Yomtov has worked on many Marvel comics series. Yomtov has been a writer, colorist and editor on tiles such as G.I. Joe, Darkhawk, and several Spider-Man issues.

name: Nicole Wiley Boose
deck: An editor that has worked at Marvel Comics.

name: Oclair Albert
deck: Inker for DC. He has worked with Geoff Johns

name: Olivier Coipel
deck: Olivier Coipel is a French comic book artist known for his work on Marvel and DC comics. His most prominent work is probably his stint on Marvel's Thor comic.

name: Olyoptics
deck: Olyoptics is not a real person, but a company created by Steve Oliff that helped pioneer the use computers in the color separation technique. Olyoptics is the first company to blend the color guide artist with the separator.

name: Oscar Gongora
deck: Letterer

name: Pablo Marcos
deck: Peruvian commercial and comic-book artist, who worked with both Marvel and DC Comics

name: Patrick Zircher
deck: An American comic book artist.

name: Paul Mounts
deck: Colorist

name: Paul Ryan
deck: An artist well known for his runs on Fantastic Four and the Avengers.

name: Peter David
deck: An acclaimed American comic book writer, well-known for his lengthy runs on Supergirl, Aquaman, Young Justice, and The Incredible Hulk.

name: Petra Goldberg
deck: Colorist.

name: Phil Rachelson
deck: Marvel colorist in the 70s, who sometimes was listed as Phil Rache.

name: Rags Morales
deck: Male comic book artist known primarily for his work on DC Comics such as Hourman and JSA.

name: Ralph Macchio
deck: Ralph Macchio, the editor, is not the same Ralph Macchio as "The Karate Kid." Although, according to an interview with Publishers Weekly from 10/15/07 if asked if he is the same Macchio: "Depending on my mood, I'll either say yes or no"

name: Randy Emberlin
deck: Inker to many well known Marvel comics, he is mabey best known for his work on the Amazing Spider-man and G.I. Joe.

name: Randy Gentile
deck: Letterer at Marvel. Works for DC.

name: Ricardo Villamonte
deck: Peruvian Artist and inker who worked for Marvel and DC in the 70's and 80's

name: Rich Buckler
deck: Richard Buckler was a comic book artist who had worked for both DC and Marvel. Primarily during the 70's through the '90s. He was also the co-creator of All-Star Squadron.

name: Rich Faber
deck: Artist.

name: Richard Case
deck: American comics book penciller; best known for his work on Grant Morrison's run of Doom Patrol.

name: Richard Howell
deck: A comic book artist best known as the co-founder and editor of Claypool Comics.

name: Richard Starkings
deck: A comic book letterer and writer. Creator of popular Image series, Elephantment, as well as creator of "Comicraft" lettering.

name: Rick Parker
deck: American letterer and artist.

name: Rick Remender
deck: Rick Remender is an American writer, penciler, and inker known for his work with Marvel, Dark Horse and Image. He is acclaimed for his writing on Uncanny X-Force and Venom for Marvel. Currently, he is the writer of Uncanny Avengers and Captain America for Marvel, and his creator owned series Low for Image Comics.

name: Roger Slifer
deck: Writer, colorist and editor during the 1970s and 1980s.

name: Roger Stern
deck: A beloved comic book writer and editor. Roger Stern has had long and incredibly well-received runs on titles such as Avengers, Superman, Captain America and Spider-Man as well as countless others.

name: Ron Wilson
deck: American comic-book artist,best known for his work with Marvel in the `70s and `80s - particularly `Marvel Two In One` and `Power Man`...

name: Roy Thomas
deck: The 2nd Editor in Chief for Marvel Comics. Also a Writer and legendary creator. Creations include Wolverine, Carol Danvers, Ghost Rider, Vision, Iron Fist, Luke Cage, Valkyrie, Morbius, Doc Samson, and Ultron. Roy has also worked for Archie, Charlton, and DC among others over the years. Currently edits the fanzine Alter Ego.

name: Rus Wooton
deck: Letterer.

name: Saida Temofonte
deck: Letterer.

name: Sal Buscema
deck: Silvio "Sal" Buscema (born on January 26, 1936 in Brooklyn, New York City, New York) is an American comic book artist - primarily for Marvel Comics. He is the brother of artist John Buscema. He is also known as "Our Pal Sal" in the language of Marvel Comics' old "Bullpen Bulletins" page.

name: Salvador Larroca
deck: Salvador Larroca is a Spanish comic book artist best known for his runs on Fantastic Four and X-Men along with his current Eisner award winning work on Invincible Iron Man. He was recently nominated for a second Eisner for best cover artist.

name: Sam Grainger
deck: Sam Grainger was one of the creators of the character Cancer (one of the members of Zodiac Cartel).

name: Sam Rosen
deck: Swingin' Sammy Rosen was one of Marvel's principal letterers during the 1960's.

name: Scott Kolins
deck: Scott Kolin is a comic book artist known for his work on The Flash, Omega Flight, Beyond!, Final Crisis: Rogue's Revenge, Marvel Team-Up, New Invaders and Avengers.

name: Scott Lobdell
deck: Scott Lobdell is an American writer best known for his work on Uncanny X-Men, Generation X and Red Hood and the Outlaws.

name: Sean Chen
deck: Chen is an Asian-American comic book artist.

name: Sean Parsons
deck: Inker.

name: Shelly Leferman
deck: Letterer.

name: Sol Brodsky
deck: Sol Brodsky was an artist who worked in both Illustration and in Production capacities and was long associated with Marvel Comics.

name: Stan Goldberg
deck: Stan Goldberg is a long time artist for Archie Comics. He is also well known for Millie the Model. He famously worked on Fantastic Four #1 as well. He is a creator who has well over 3,000 issues under his belt!

name: Stan Lee
deck: Stan "The Man" Lee, Marvel Comics's legendary founder, is the writer and co-creator of such timeless characters as the Avengers, the X-Men, Spider-Man, Iron Man, the Fantastic Four, and the Hulk. In his words, "'Nuff said!" His best-known catch-phrase is New York's state motto, "Excelsior!!!"

name: Stephen Sadowski
deck: Penciler

name: Steve Behling
deck: Worked as an editor for Marvel.

name: Steve Ditko
deck: An American comic book artist and comic book writer. He is best known as the co-creator of Spider-Man and Doctor Strange.

name: Steve Englehart
deck: Writer for DC and Marvel who worked on several major characters and teams in both universes and later launched several Malibu Ultraverse and Valiant titles.

name: Steve Epting
deck: Comic book artist Steve Epting is best known for illustrating controversial stories on two of Marvel’s flagship titles, Captain America and Fantastic Four.

name: Steve Gerber
deck: Prolific writer for Marvel in the Seventies, creating such titles as Howard the Duck and Omega the Unknown, among others.

name: Steve Oliff
deck: American writer and artist best known for his work on Spawn and Akira.

name: Steven Grant
deck: American comic book writer.

name: Stuart Immonen
deck: Stuart Immonen is a Canadian comic book artist that has worked for both DC and Marvel Comics as well as for Top Cow and Image Comics. Husband to comic writer Kathryn Immonen. He often works with Brian Michael Bendis and he is often inked by Wade Von Grawbadger.

name: Terry Austin
deck: Terry Austin is one of comic's most famous inkers.

name: Terry Dodson
deck: An American comic book artist who often works alongside his wife, Rachel Dodson.

name: Terry Szenics
deck: Letterer who worked for Marvel during the 60s, besides lettering Terry Szenics (maiden name Cloiks) worked on humor books in the 50s and 60s, most notably as Harry Lucey's regular inker at Archie Comics for years. Her brush work was stunning and very little is written about her.

name: Tim Townsend
deck: Tim Townsend is an artist who has collaborated with some of the best creators/artists in comics.

name: Todd Klein
deck: Todd Klein is one of the most recognized names in comic book lettering and has worked on hundreds of titles. He is mostly known for his work at DC/Vertigo, including his critically acclaimed lettering on Neil Gaiman's The Sandman. He has won numerous awards including the Eisner award for Best Letterer several times.

name: Tom Brevoort
deck: Tom Brevoort is currently the Senior Vice President of Publishing at Marvel Comics.

name: Tom Chu
deck: Colorist.

name: Tom DeFalco
deck: Writer and former editor for Marvel Comics.

name: Tom Orzechowski
deck: Tom Orzechowski is a lettering veteran best known as the letterer of the Silver Age X-Men titles.

name: Tom Palmer
deck: Artist

name: Tom Simmons
deck: Inker.

name: Tony Kelly
deck: Colorist and leader of Kell-O-Graphics.

name: Typeset
deck: A typewriter / word processor lettering system.

name: Wade von Grawbadger
deck: Inker. Has worked for DC and Marvel, best known for Starman for DC Comics.

name: Walden Wong
deck: Walden Wong is a well-respected comic book artist/inker and has a wide range of experience in the industry. He has worked for practically every publisher out there, including DC, Marvel, Image, Dark Horse, and VIZ media. You can see his name on a variety of titles every year.

name: Wes Abbott
deck: Letterer.

name: Yanick Paquette
deck: Artist. Has worked on Civil War: X-Men, Ultimate X-Men, and Seven Soldiers: Bulleteer.
